name: core-runtime-database-leadconvert-dto-local-evidence
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves Glade-local Database.LeadConvert DTO property aliases and Object methods. It does not execute lead conversion and grants zero Salesforce parity credit.

source.content: Database.LeadConvert convert = new Database.LeadConvert(); convert.accountrecord = new Account(Name = 'Account'); convert.bypassaccountdedupecheck = true; convert.bypasscontactdedupecheck = false; convert.contactrecord = new Contact(LastName = 'Contact'); convert.convertedstatus = 'Qualified'; convert.donotcreateopportunity = true; convert.opportunityrecord = new Opportunity(Name = 'Opportunity'); convert.relatedpersonaccountrecord = new Account(Name = 'Person'); System.assertEquals(convert.getAccountRecord(), convert.accountrecord); System.assertEquals(convert.getBypassAccountDedupeCheck(), convert.bypassaccountdedupecheck); System.assertEquals(convert.getBypassContactDedupeCheck(), convert.bypasscontactdedupecheck); System.assertEquals(convert.getContactRecord(), convert.contactrecord); System.assertEquals(convert.getConvertedStatus(), convert.convertedstatus); System.assertEquals(convert.isDoNotCreateOpportunity(), convert.donotcreateopportunity); System.assertEquals(convert.getOpportunityRecord(), convert.opportunityrecord); System.assertEquals(convert.getRelatedPersonAccountRecord(), convert.relatedpersonaccountrecord); System.assert(convert.equals(convert)); System.assert(!convert.equals(null)); System.assertEquals(convert.hashCode(), convert.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, convert.toString());
